fixtures.description: A 5 percent targeted delivery rollout, the value the public API docs use ("0.05 is a 5% rollout"). summary.served records how many of the 200 contexts the reference serves.
The 30 percent rollout the production QA found serving all 200 of 200 visitors. summary.served records how many of these 200 contexts the reference serves.
A 50 percent targeted delivery rollout. summary.served records how many of the 200 contexts the reference serves.

A 0.12345 rollout: the threshold is 1234.5, half a bucket from any integer. The first two contexts are searched keys on allocation buckets 1234 (served) and 1235 (not served); a port that floors the threshold disagrees on the first one.
A 100 percent rollout: every one of the 200 contexts is served.
No allocation at all (null): the rule has no gate and serves all 200 contexts, exactly as targeted delivery behaved before rollouts existed.
